newsitem.title: CANADA: Prairie grain elevator space tightens on harvest.
newsitem.headline: Prairie grain elevator space tightens on harvest.

text.p: Primary grain elevator space tightened up on Canada's prairies compared to last week as farmers delivered harvested grains, the Canadian Wheat Board said.

Prairie elevators posted an average available space of 24 percent. Alberta showed the most space at 36 percent, down from last week's 39 percent. Saskatchewan had 21 percent of space available, down from 22 percent last week. Manitoba had 14 percent of space available, up from 13 percent last week.
Rail hopper car unloads at Canada's West Coast reached 3,552 in the week ended September 29, below the target of 3,750.
Unloads at Thunder Bay were 2,815, above the 1,990 target.
Unloads at Churchill were 331, above the 300 target.
